Plants of the World Online account: Penstemon × gloxinioides Purdy.

The hybrid formula of this artificial cross is P. campanulatus × P. cobaea × P. gentianoides × P. hartwegii × P. isophyllus.
sources.identityDecision: Exact scientific name in primary account heading; no use of synonym target or member-species account
